india.one_line: Cognizant expands Anthropic AI, investors favor capital‑light AI firms, Sarvam AI hires ex‑Google exec, GCCs deepen AI ties

themes.title: Cognizant launches Claude AI group
themes.text: Cognizant created a Claude Frontier Capability Group, assigning over 25,000 staff and training more than 44,000 associates to deliver Anthropic’s AI assistant and offering managed services for production.

stories.headline: Cognizant forms Claude Frontier Capability Group with 25,000 staff

themes.title: Investors prefer capital‑light AI firms
themes.text: An Anand Rathi report notes that investors are shifting toward IT companies that can monetize enterprise AI without large capital outlays, giving an advantage to capital‑light firms.

stories.headline: IT firms with lower capital requirements may gain as investors shift focus to AI monetisation: Report

themes.title: Sarvam AI hires ex‑Google Cloud MD
themes.text: Indian AI startup Sarvam AI appointed former Google Cloud India Managing Director Sashikumar Sreedharan as President and Chief Business Officer, adding three decades of tech experience.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI appoints ex-Google Cloud India MD Sashikumar Sreedharan as President and CBO

themes.title: GCCs and IT firms partner on AI
themes.text: Global Capability Centres and Indian IT services firms are forming enterprise AI partnerships, with a study rating India’s GCC ecosystem at 61.9 and noting limited budget authority among most GCCs.

stories.headline: India's GCCs and IT firms form enterprise AI partnerships
